lines.t: Clean hair, soft seats, Bibles folded tight
We know the rules, we shine our light
We shake the hands, we pass the plate
We keep the standard line
We call it faith, we call it home
We say the temple's fine
He tells me my plumb line stands in midst
The trumpet sounds the hour
Come out, sell, house, sell, steeple, sell
All that props your power, give it to the poor
Lay yourself upon my stone
Follow me
Hey, what's the deal?
I kept the rules
I give when asked
I sing your songs
He tells me you
Will be tried, you will be sifted
Give me the things you've kept too long
I don't sleep around, I don't steal
My name's clean, my life is fair
Telling me I want the things you just won't give me
Come out of comfort's snare
He says come out, come out
The harvest press is hard
The line is drawn, my door will close
I hear the call, the price is clear
I taste the cost, can I let go?
Hey, what's the deal? I kept the rules
I gave when I stopped, sung your songs
Telling me you are tried, you are sifted
Give me all that you are, don't wait too long
I will try to come
But can I take the leap?
Thank you.
